blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Idioms have long been a challenge for machine translation, and while large language models (LLMs) have proven increasingly adept at handling them, whether quality estimation (QE) systems have kept pace and can reliably score idiomatic renderings of these expressions above faulty literal ones remains unclear. We introduce the first parallel dataset pairing idiom-bearing English sentences with both literal and idiomatic translations across nine target languages, augmented into multi-sentence segments and a graded literality continuum. Using this dataset, we benchmark eleven conventional QE metrics from the COMET and MetricX families and ten LLMs from the Qwen-3, Gemma-4 and OLMo-3 families used as GEMBA-style judges. We find that most systems, especially older metrics and smaller models, display a marked literality bias, rating literal translations of idioms above idiomatic ones. Higher parameter counts and newer training sets appear to reduce this bias to an extent; nevertheless, of all the benchmarked systems, only MetricX-24-Hybrid (XL, XXL) and Gemma-4-31B consistently rate idiomatic translations of idioms above literal ones, and only Gemma-4-31B reliably ranks intermediate degrees of idiomaticity and literality. Our findings caution against deploying standard QE metrics in domains rich in figurative language, where higher scores might be rewarding undesirable literalism.
blocks.zh: 对机器翻译来说,偶像长期以来一直是一个挑战,虽然大型语言模型(LLMs)已经证明越来越适合处理这些模型,但质量估计(QE)系统是否保持了速度,能否可靠地将这些表达值的平面渲染得高于有缺陷的字面渲染,仍然不清楚. 我们引入了第一个平行的数据集,将含平话的英语句子配对,同时在9个目标语言中进行字面和平话翻译,并扩充成多句判决部分和分级的平话连续语. 利用这个数据集,我们衡量了来自彗星和MetricX家族的11个常规QE度量衡,以及来自Quen-3、Gemma-4和OLMo-3家族的10个LLMs度量衡。 我们发现大多数系统,尤其是更古老的度量衡和更小的模型, 都表现出明显的字面偏差, 将平庸的字面翻译评为平庸的。 更高的参数计数和较新的培训集似乎在一定程度上减少了这种偏差;然而,在所有基准系统中,只有MetricX-24-Hybrid(XL,XXL)和Gemma-4-31B在字面上一致的平面翻译,只有Gemma-4-31B可靠地排列了平面和字面的中间度. 我们的调查结果告诫不要在富于比喻性语言的领域采用标准QE的衡量标准,因为在那些领域,较高的分数可能会奖励不良的文字主义。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Idioms are formulaic phrases whose meaning cannot be deduced from the semantic analysis of their isolated constituents: I have other fish to fry (‘I have more important things to care about’); they’re cutting corners (‘they are trying to save money at the expense of quality and safety’). Idioms can be borrowed through calques between languages in contact, inherited from a common ancestor language, or acquired identically through independent convergence, in which cases they might be translatable literally. Such is rarely the case, however, and idioms generally rule out literal translation, instead requiring the use of complex techniques of paraphrase and cultural equivalence. For this reason, idioms have historically posed a significant challenge in machine translation (MT) research, and were once even cited as proof of the impossibility of MT as a task ( Bar-Hillel, 1952 ) , with guidelines to academic MT users recommending their removal from system input ( Bowker and Ciro, 2019 ) .
blocks.zh: 偶数是公式化短语,其含义不能从对孤立成分的语义分析中推导出来: 我还有别的鱼要煎(`我有更重要的事情要关心');它们正在割角(`它们试图以质量和安全为代价节省资金')。 隔音可以通过接触中的各种语言之间的卡路里借入,从共同的祖先语言中继承,或者通过独立汇合而获得,在这种情况下,它们可能从字面上可转换. 然而,这种情况很少发生,通常一般不采用字面翻译,而是要求使用复杂的解释手法和文化等同。 因此,idioms在历史上对机器翻译(MT)研究构成重大挑战,甚至一度被引用为MT不可能作为任务的证据(Bar-Hillel,1952年),同时向学术MT用户提出准则建议将其从系统输入中移除(Bowker和Ciro,2019年).

blocks.en: MT research has since progressed by leaps and bounds ( Sutskever et al., 2014 ; Bahdanau et al., 2015 ; Vaswani et al., 2017 ) , and the shift to large language models (LLMs) has led to substantial improvements in the translation of figurative language and multi-word expressions ( Raunak et al., 2023 ) —categories to which idioms belong—as the large parametric memory of these models and the gargantuan volumes of text data used to train them enhance their ability to learn these constructions. Whether the evaluation and benchmarking apparatus of MT has kept pace remains unclear, however, particularly with respect to quality estimation (QE) techniques.
blocks.zh: 之后MT研究通过跃进和极限(Sutskever等人,2014年;Bahdanau等人,2015年;Vaswani等人,2017年)取得了进步,向大语言模型(LLMS)的转变,使得比喻语言和多词表达(Raunak等人,2023年)的翻译有了实质性的改进——这些模型属于类——作为这些模型的巨大参数记忆,以及用来培训这些模型的gargantuan文本数据量增强了他们学习这些构造的能力. 然而,MT的评价和基准机制是否保持了速度,仍然不清楚,特别是在质量估计技术方面。

blocks.en: QE consists in evaluating the quality of a candidate translation on the sole basis of its source segment, without a gold standard reference translation. Such a task is eminently useful. In real-world applications, the existence of a reference translation would naturally obviate the need for a candidate translation. While the actual extent of QE “deployment” in the context of contemporary translation practices is partly obscured by trade secrets, clues within the research output of language service providers and the publications of industry analysts indicate that QE systems are likely assuming a growing role in contemporary translation workflows ( Rei et al., 2022 ; Edwards, 2023 ; Guerreiro et al., 2024 ; Stasimioti, 2025 ) . In MT research, QE metrics likewise serve an increasing range of functions, from data filtering for in-context learning ( Sharami et al., 2024 ) to applications in quality-aware decoding ( Fernandes et al., 2022 ; Koneru et al., 2025 ; Mrozinski et al., 2025 ) . In light of these roles and growing importance, developing a better understanding of the properties and behaviors of dominant QE systems has become an imperative, 1 1 1 As shown by the recent creation within AMTA of a working group to standardize QE system evaluation ( Stasimioti, 2026 ) . with notable past work analyzing the gender biases these QE systems might display ( Zaranis et al., 2025 ) . The present work aims to study the performance of dominant QE approaches in idiom translation.
blocks.zh: QE包括仅根据其来源部分评价候选翻译的质量,而没有金本位参考翻译. 这项任务非常有益。 在现实世界的应用中,如果有参考翻译,自然就不需要候选人翻译。 虽然QE“部署”在当代翻译做法中的实际范围部分被商业秘密所掩盖,但语言服务提供者的研究产出和行业分析员的出版物中的线索表明,QE系统在当代翻译工作流程中可能正在发挥越来越大的作用(Rei等人,2022年;Edwards,2023年;Guerreiro等人,2024年;Stasimioti,2025年)。 在MT研究中,QE度量衡同样发挥越来越大的功能范围,从数据过滤用于文本内学习(Sharami等人,2024年)到质量意识解码方面的应用(Fernandes等人,2022年;Koneru等人,2025年;Mrozinski等人,2025年)。 鉴于这些作用和日益重要,必须更好地了解占主导地位的质量控制制度的性质与行为。 1 11 正如最近在AMTA内部设立的一个工作组所显示的,该工作组旨在标准化质量控制制度评价(Stasimioti, 2026年),过去对这些质量控制制度可能表现出的性别偏见进行了显著分析(Zaranis等人,2025年)。 目前的工作旨在研究主流量化排放方法在idiom翻译方面的表现。

blocks.en: Through this work, we introduce the first parallel dataset pairing idiom-bearing English sentences with both literal and idiomatic translations across nine target languages, and use it to benchmark eleven conventional QE metrics from the COMET and MetricX families and ten LLMs from the Qwen-3, Gemma-4 and OLMo-3 families used as GEMBA-style judges. We find that most systems, especially older metrics and smaller models, show a marked literality bias, rating literal translations of idioms above idiomatic ones. While larger parameter counts and more recent training sets reduce this bias, of all the benchmarked systems, only MetricX-24-Hybrid (XL, XXL) and Gemma-4-31B consistently rate idiomatic translations of idioms above literal ones, and only Gemma-4-31B reliably ranks intermediate degrees of idiomaticity and literality. Our findings caution against deploying standard QE metrics in domains rich in figurative language, where high scores might be rewarding undesirable literalism.
blocks.zh: 通过这项工作,我们引入了第一个平行的数据集,将含有二元的英文句子配对,并用九种目标语言的字面翻译和二元翻译,并用它作为基准,衡量来自彗星和MetricX家族的11个常规QE指标,以及来自Quen-3、Gemma-4和OLMo-3家族的10个LLM,作为GEMBA型法官。 我们发现,大多数系统,特别是更古老的度量衡和较小的模型,都显示出明显的字面偏差,对平庸的度量论的字面翻译高于平庸的度量论. 虽然较大的参数数和较近期的训练集减少了这种偏差,但在所有基准系统中,只有MetricX-24-Hybrid(XL,XXL)和Gemma-4-31B在字面上一致的平面翻译,只有Gemma-4-31B在字面上可靠地排列了平面和字面的中间度. 我们的调查结果告诫不要在富于比喻性语言的领域采用标准QE衡量标准,因为高分可能奖励不可取的文字主义。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: In this section we describe the methods we applied to the study of QE in idiom translation, presenting the dataset we compiled and the QE metrics we benchmarked using it.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们描述了我们在研究量化宽松时采用的方法,即用idiom翻译,介绍我们所汇编的数据集以及我们用它作为基准的量化宽松指标。

blocks.en: 2.1 Idiom Dataset
blocks.zh: 2.1 数字集

blocks.en: To the best of our knowledge, while there exist many idiom datasets (see Related Work), none of these corpora systematically features paired idiomatic and literal translations of idiom-bearing sentences, in any language. Such a resource would be of precious help to researchers interested in studying a variety of phenomena (e.g., literality bias, literary translation performance), topics of growing importance in MT research ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Raunak et al., 2023 ; Kocmi et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 就我们所知,虽然存在许多idiom数据集(见相关工作),但这些corpora没有一种系统化的功能是将含有idiom的句子成对地和字面地翻译,用任何语言翻译. 这种资源对研究各种现象(如文学偏差、文学翻译表现)的研究人员将具有宝贵的帮助,这些专题在MT研究中越来越重要(Wang等人,2023年;Wang等人,2024年;Raunak等人,2023年;Kocmi等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: To address this gap, we constructed a parallel dataset across nine target languages: Arabic, Chinese, French, Italian, Japanese, Modern Greek, Russian, Spanish, and Turkish, with English as the source language.
blocks.zh: 为了弥补这一差距,我们构建了9种目标语言的并行数据集:阿拉伯语、中文、法语、意大利语、日语、现代希腊语、俄语、西班牙语和土耳其语,以英语为源语言。

blocks.zh: 表1:单一判决基础三胞胎的例子,主要表现为英语来源的idiom及其极具文字性和流畅的idiomic翻译.

blocks.en: The core of the dataset comprises 163 one-sentence triplets, with each triplet consisting of an English source sentence containing an idiom, paired with both a highly literal translation and a fluent idiomatic translation (see Table 1 for a sample). These base triplets were manually curated on the basis of lexicographical resources and the linguistic competence of the authors and their native-speaker colleagues. Each triplet had to meet the two following conditions: 1) the English idiom needed to have a readily identifiable equivalent in the target language and 2) said equivalent target idiom needed to differ from a literal rendering of the English source idiom. As a consequence, the resulting base dataset is not strictly multiparallel since these conditions could not be uniformly met across all target languages for any given English source idiom. The per-target-language distribution of these base triplets is as follows: Spanish (38 triplets), French (20 triplets), and 15 triplets each for the remaining seven languages.
blocks.zh: 数据集的核心部分包括163个一判决三胞胎,每个三胞胎由一个英文源句组成,包含一个idiom,配对同时配有高字形翻译和流利的idiomic翻译(样本见表1)。 这些基础三胞胎是依据词典资源和作者及其母语同事的语言能力而手工整理的。 每个三胞胎必须满足以下两个条件: 1)英语的idiom需要在目标语言中具有易于识别的等效性,2)说,等效的目标idiom需要与英语源idiom的字面渲染不同. 因此,由此产生的基础数据集并非绝对是多平行的,因为这些条件无法在所有目标语言中统一满足任何特定英语源的idiom。 这些基础三胞胎的每个目标语言分布如下:西班牙语(38个三胞胎),法语(20个三胞胎),其余7种语言各15个三胞胎.

blocks.en: We applied a data augmentation strategy to these base triplet instances in order to generate multi-sentence segments. For each target language, we randomly sampled and concatenated base triplets into new instances of varying lengths ( L ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } L\in\{2,3,4,5\} sentences). We generated exactly N = 300 N=300 unique combinations for each length, resulting in 1,200 augmented multi-sentence segments per language pair (see Table 2 for a data sample).
blocks.zh: 我们对这些基本三胞胎案例采用了数据扩充战略,以便形成多判决部分。 对于每种目标语言,我们随机抽取和调制的基数三进制成不同长度的新例(L {{2,3,4,5}L\in}2,3,4,5}句子). 我们每个长度产生准确的N=300N=300个独特组合,结果每个语言对产生1 200个增强的多刑部分(数据样本见表2)。

blocks.en: Judgments of literality/idiomaticity exist on a continuous spectrum rather than as a strict dichotomy. To test the models’ sensitivity to graded changes in literality, we constructed 300 instances per target language by concatenating three base triplets ( L = 3 L=3 ). For each instance, we generated four target variants in which 0, 1, 2, or all 3 sentences (selected at random) are literal translations and the remainder idiomatic, yielding a literality gradient of 0%, 33%, 66%, and 100% (see Table 3 for examples).
blocks.zh: 对字面性/偏执性的判断存在于连续的频谱上,而不是严格的二分法. 为了测试这些模型对升词的分级变化的敏感性,我们通过调和3个基数三进制(L=3 L=3),构建了每个目标语言的300个实例。 在每个例子中,我们产生了4个目标变体,其中0、1、2或所有3句(随机选择)是文字翻译和其余的平面翻译,其字面梯度为0%、33%、66%和100%(例子见表3)。

blocks.en: Table 3: Examples of the semantic gradient for concatenated segments ( L = 3 L=3 ). The intermediate steps (66% and 33% literal) randomly mix literal and idiomatic sentence-level translations to test granular sensitivity.
blocks.zh: 表3:缩合部分语义梯度实例(L=3L=3). 中间步骤(66%和33%升)随机混合文字和平庸的句子层次翻译,以测试颗粒灵敏度.

blocks.en: 2.2 QE System Query
blocks.zh: 2.2 QE 系统查询

blocks.en: To find the “lay of the land” in idiom-translation QE, we conducted extensive experiments, prompting a wide range of conventional QE systems and LLMs in a GEMBA-style regime to provide QE scores for the segments in our dataset, before computing deltas between the scores obtained by the literal and idiomatic translations for a given system. The following sections present the QE systems we queried.
blocks.zh: 为了在平面翻译QE中找到“土地的铺设”,我们进行了广泛的实验,在计算某一系统的平面翻译和平面翻译所得分数之间的三角洲之前,在GEMBA式制度中,促使各种常规的QE系统和LLMs为我们数据集中的分数提供QE分数。 以下各节介绍我们所询问的质量控制系统。

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Conventional QE Systems
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 常规QE系统

blocks.en: Conventional QE relies on dedicated models trained to regress on human judgments from past WMT evaluation campaigns, chiefly direct assessment (DA) scores ( Graham et al., 2013 ) and the more fine-grained MQM annotations ( Lommel et al., 2013 ) . We tested eleven such systems from two dominant families. From the COMET family, we used wmt22-cometkiwi-da 3 3 3 Unbabel/wmt22-cometkiwi-da ( Rei et al., 2022 ) , built on top of InfoXLM ( Chi et al., 2021 , approx. 600M parameters; ) ; its XL and XXL successors wmt23-cometkiwi-da-xl 4 4 4 Unbabel/wmt23-cometkiwi-da-xl and wmt23-cometkiwi-da-xxl 5 5 5 Unbabel/wmt23-cometkiwi-da-xxl ( Rei et al., 2023 ) , built on XLM-R XL and XXL ( Conneau et al., 2020 , 3.5B and 10.5B parameters, respectively; ) ; and XCOMET-XL 6 6 6 Unbabel/XCOMET-XL and XCOMET-XXL 7 7 7 Unbabel/XCOMET-XXL ( Guerreiro et al., 2024 ) , which unify reference-based and reference-free evaluation with error span detection while relying on the same base models. Ensembles of these models ranked first at the WMT 2022–2024 QE shared tasks ( Zerva et al., 2022 ; Blain et al., 2023 ; Zerva et al., 2024 ) . From the MetricX family, built on top of mT5 ( Xue et al., 2021 ) , we used metricx-23-qe-large , 8 8 8 google/metricx-23-qe-large-v2p0 metricx-23-qe-xl 9 9 9 google/metricx-23-qe-xl-v2p0 and metricx-23-qe-xxl 10 10 10 google/metricx-23-qe-xxl-v2p0 ( Juraska et al., 2023 , 1.2B, 3.7B and 13B parameters, respectively; ) , and metricx-24-hybrid-large , 11 11 11 google/metricx-24-hybrid-large-v2p6 metricx-24-hybrid-xl , 12 12 12 google/metricx-24-hybrid-xl-v2p6 metricx-24-hybrid-xxl 13 13 13 google/metricx-24-hybrid-xxl-v2p6-bfloat16 ( Juraska et al., 2024 , 1.2B, 3.7B and 13B parameters, respectively; ) , the latter additionally trained on synthetic data covering failure modes underrepresented in WMT data (e.g., fluent but unrelated translations). 14 14 14 MetricX-25 ( Juraska et al., 2025 ) was not open-sourced and could not be included. COMET models were run with the unbabel-comet library, 15 15 15 https://github.com/Unbabel/COMET and MetricX models through the Transformers library ( Wolf et al., 2020 ) . All models were run at full precision, except metricx-24-hybrid-xxl, for which we used the official bfloat16 checkpoint due to hardware constraints.

blocks.en: 2.2.2 LLMs
blocks.zh: 2.2.2 法学硕士

blocks.en: LLM-as-a-judge approaches have achieved increasingly competitive results in dedicated QE shared tasks ( Zerva et al., 2024 ; Lavie et al., 2025 ) , notably through GEMBA-style prompting ( Kocmi and Federmann, 2023 ) . Following Zaranis et al. (2025) , we adopted zero-shot DA-style prompts for our task, presenting the LLM with an English source segment containing an idiom and a candidate translation (either literal or idiomatic) from our dataset, demanding that it output a score between 0 (“no meaning preserved”) and 100 (“perfect meaning and grammar”). The full prompt templates are given in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: LLM-as-a-judge方法在专门的QE共享任务(Zerva等人,2024年;Lavie等人,2025年)中取得了越来越具有竞争力的结果,特别是通过GEMBA式的提示(Kocmi和Federmann,2023年)。 继Zaranis等人(2025年)之后,我们为我们的任务采用了零镜头DA风格的提示,向LLM呈现了包含一个idiom的英语源段,以及一个来自我们数据集的候选翻译(或字面翻译或异构翻译),要求它输出0(没有保留意义)到100(完美含义和语法)之间的分数. 完整的即时模板见附录A。

blocks.en: We selected a total of 10 LLMs as QE judges, from 3 model families: Qwen-3-32B Yang et al. (2025) , a reasoning LLM with 32 billion parameters, and Qwen-3-14B , Qwen-3-8B , Qwen-3-1.7B , and Qwen-3-0.6B , its smaller distilled variants; Olmo-3-32B-Think Olmo et al. blocks.en: To investigate the impact of reasoning on the task at hand, the Qwen-3 and Gemma-4 models were prompted under two distinct settings, one with their reasoning mode turned on and the other with this mode turned off, using slightly different prompt templates and hyperparameters (see Appendix A ). Inference was conducted using H100 GPU nodes, the vLLM framework ( Kwon et al., 2023 ) and the Transformers library ( Wolf et al., 2020 ) with greedy decoding ( t = 0 t=0 ), and the max-tokens parameter set to 50 for the reasoning-off setting, and to 16,384 tokens for the reasoning-on setting.

For quality metrics (all COMET-derived systems and GEMBA scores), this is expressed as the ratio of the mean score assigned to fully literal translations over the mean score assigned to the fully idiomatic translations. For error-based metrics (MetricX), the ratio is inverted for legibility purposes: PR = { s ¯ lit s ¯ idio for quality-based metrics (COMET, GEMBA) , s ¯ idio s ¯ lit for error-based metrics (MetricX) , \mathrm{PR}=\begin{cases}\dfrac{\bar{s}_{\mathrm{lit}}}{\bar{s}_{\mathrm{idio}}}&\text{for quality-based metrics (COMET, GEMBA)},\\[10.0pt]

blocks.en: An analysis of the “conventional” COMET and MetricX QE systems reveals that the ability to reward idiomaticity in idiom translation—and, conversely, to penalize literality—is driven by an interplay between model scale and finetuning data composition. The impact of the latter is evidenced by the observable “generational” shift within the MetricX system family: despite matching parameter counts across their Large (1.2B), XL (3.7B), and XXL (13B) mT5-derived checkpoints, the MetricX-24-Hybrid group effectively suppresses the severe literality bias exhibited by its predecessor, MetricX-23-QE. This improvement is likely attributable to MetricX-24’s exposure to larger MQM training sets and/or to the hybrid nature of the model, capable of performing both QE and reference-based evaluation. A similar though fainter trend of improvement is visible between the WMT23 COMET-Kiwi models and the newer XCOMET architecture. Concurrently, a scaling law appears to govern QE performance in idiom translation. Scaling up parameter counts—such as moving from Large to XXL in MetricX-24, or from XL (3.5B) to XXL (10.5B) in XCOMET—consistently shifts the metrics away from a literal bias and toward an idiomatic preference. This is likely due to the non-compositional nature of idioms: since their meaning cannot be deduced analytically, recognizing idioms and their idiomatic equivalent in a target language depends on memorized knowledge of specific expressions, which inherently benefits from the increased parametric memory of larger models. Ultimately, reliable idiomatic sensitivity in conventional QE systems is currently only achieved by the XL and XXL checkpoint of MetricX-24-Hybrid.
blocks.zh: 对 " 常规 " 彗星和MetricX QE系统的分析表明,在idiom翻译中奖励异乎寻常——反之,惩罚字迹——的能力是由模型尺度和微调数据组成之间的相互作用推动的。 后者的影响表现在MetricX系统家族内可观察到的“世代”变化:尽管在大(1.2B)、XL(3.7B)和XXL(13B)mT5产生的检查站之间有相应的参数,MetricX-24-Hybrid集团有效地抑制了其前身MetricX-23-QE所表现出的严重字面偏差。 这一改善可能归因于MetricX-24接触了更大的MQM培训机组和(或)模型的混合性质,既能够进行QE,又能够进行基于参考的评价。 WMT23 COMET-Kiwi模型和较新的XCOMET架构之间也出现了类似但稍微的改进趋势。 同时,一个缩放法似乎适用于idiom翻译中的QE性能. 放大参数计数——例如MetricX-24中从大值移到XXL,或XCOMET中从XL(3.5B)移到XXL(10.5B)——持续地将衡量尺度从字面偏差转向偏好。 这可能是由于idioms的非组合性质:由于它们的含义不能从分析上推导出来,所以在目标语言中识别idioms及其等效的idioms取决于对特定表达的记忆性知识,而对于较大模型的参数记忆性增强,这在本质上是有好处的. 归根结底,常规QE系统中可靠的异构灵敏度目前只有MetricX-24-Hybrid的XL和XXL检查站才能实现.

blocks.en: When using LLMs as QE judges under the GEMBA framework, sensitivity to idiomaticity is characterized by stark inter-family variance and diverse scaling trajectories. The Qwen 3 family exhibits a distinct, non-linear progression: its smallest checkpoint (0.6B) gives preference ratios hovering tightly around 1.0, indicating that it is effectively blind to the distinction between literal and idiomatic phrasing. As parameter count increases (1.7B and 8B), the models develop a severe literality bias, before eventually tilting toward an idiomatic preference at the 32B scale for a majority of the target languages, though not for their totality, with Arabic and Greek eliciting a literality bias and Turkish neutral judgments. Conversely, the Gemma 4 family bypasses this initial blindness entirely. Even its smallest edge-optimized model (E2B) actively differentiates translations, albeit unreliably—exhibiting an extreme literality bias for target segments in Greek (incidentally the lowest-resource target language represented in our dataset) and to a lesser extent in Arabic and Italian with its reasoning mode switched on. Scaling up the Gemma parameter count rapidly stabilizes this behavior: Gemma-4-E4B achieves broad idiomatic preference, albeit with a persistent literality bias in Greek, and Gemma-4-31B demonstrates a uniform robust preference for idiomaticity across all target languages. Parameter scale does not compensate for everything, however. Although OLMo-3-32B shows a weaker literality bias than its 7B counterpart, it remains well behind Qwen-3 and Gemma-4 models of comparable size. OLMo differs from these models in its training data, both in pretraining and post-training, and in particular in its far more limited multilingual coverage. This suggests that scale helps only insofar as the relevant idiomatic knowledge has been acquired during training.
blocks.zh: 在GEMBA框架下使用LLMS作为QE评委时,对异质性的敏感度具有明显的家族间差异和多样的缩放轨迹的特征. Quen 3家族表现出明显的非线性进展:其最小的检查点(0.6B)给予徘徊在1.0左右的偏好比率,表明它实际上对字面和平面措辞的区别视而不见. 随着参数数的增加(1.7B和8B),模型发展出严重的字面偏差,最终在32B尺度上向多数目标语言偏好倾斜,尽管不是全部,阿拉伯语和希腊语引起了字面偏差和土耳其中性判断. 相反,Gemma 4家族完全绕过了这种最初的失明. 即使其最小的边缘优化模型(E2B)也积极区分翻译,尽管这种翻译不可靠——对希腊语的目标部分(恰巧是我们数据集中代表的最低限度资源目标语言)和在较小程度上对阿拉伯语和意大利语的翻译具有极端的字面偏差,其推理模式被打开。 Gemma 参数的缩放快速稳定了这种行为: Gemma-4-E4B实现广泛的偏好,尽管希腊语中存在持续的字面偏好,Gemma-4-31B表现出在所有目标语言中一致的强烈偏好. 然而,参数尺度并不能补偿一切。 虽然OLMo-3-3-32B显示出比其7B对应体更弱的字面偏差,但它仍然远远落后于相当大小的Quen-3和Gemma-4模型. 法律厅在培训前和培训后数据方面都与这些模式不同,特别是其多语种覆盖面非常有限。 这表明,只有在培训期间获得相关平庸知识时,规模才有帮助。

blocks.en: LLMs as QE judges therefore have checkered performance, with Gemma-4-31B as the only LLM reliably capable of penalizing literality in idiom translation over idiomaticity.
blocks.zh: 因此,LLMS作为QE法官检查了业绩,Gemma-4-31B是唯一可靠地能够惩罚平庸翻译中的字迹的LLM。

blocks.en: As previously stated, judgments of literality and idiomaticity exist on a continuous scale rather than as a strictly binary dichotomy. To evaluate the systems’ sensitivity to more granular degrees of idiomaticity, we analyzed their performance on the graded L = 3 L=3 dataset partition we compiled, which features three-sentence segments representing various degrees of literality/idiomaticity (100%, 66%, 33%, and 0% literal permutations; see Table 3 ). For each three-sentence instance, we calculated Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} rank correlation coefficient ( Kendall, 1938 ) to measure how closely a model’s predicted scores aligned with the ideal 4-step idiomaticity gradient the segments represent. Kendall’s τ \tau evaluates the ordinal association between two measured quantities; in the context of this experiment, a τ \tau of 1.0 1.0 indicates a perfect monotonic preference for idiomaticity (correctly ranking all four steps of the gradient in the right order), a τ \tau near 0.0 0.0 indicates random scoring, and a negative τ \tau denotes an active preference for literal translations. The mean segment-level τ \tau scores are displayed in Table 5 and broadly corroborate the binary macro-preference trends: older “conventional” QE metrics and smaller LLM checkpoints exhibit strong negative correlations, heavily penalizing idiomaticity. Crucially, however, evaluating rank order across intermediate steps provides the resolution needed to separate the top-performing systems. While metricx_24_hybrid_xxl and gemba_gemma4_31b appeared roughly on par when evaluating the binary extremes of full literality and idiomaticity, this Kendall’s τ \tau analysis reveals the performance boundaries of the “conventional” QE metric. Metricx_24_hybrid_xxl struggles to reliably rank the intermediate 33% and 66% sentence mixtures, resulting in only moderate correlations on languages like Arabic ( τ = 0.355 \tau=0.355 ) and French ( τ = 0.387 \tau=0.387 ). In stark contrast, gemba_gemma4_31b maintains near-perfect monotonic tracking across the board, achieving τ \tau scores above 0.900 0.900 for the vast majority of languages. This suggests that while large conventional systems reliably capture extreme contrasts, the 31B LLM is substantially better equipped to track subtle “real-world” gradations of idiomaticity and literality.
blocks.zh: 如前所述,对字面性和平面性的判断是持续存在的,而不是严格的二元二分法. 为了评估这些系统对更微粒性偏振度的敏感度,我们分析了它们在我们编译的L=3 L=3数据集分区上的性能,该分区的特征是代表不同程度的字迹/偏振(100%、66%、33%和0%;见表3)。 每三次判决,我们计算了肯德尔的\ b\ tau_{b} 等级关联系数(Kendall,1938年),以衡量一个模型的预测分数如何接近这些部分所代表的理想的四步偏差梯度。 Kendall 的 \ tau 评估了两个测量量之间的正统关系;在这个实验中, \ tau 的 1.0 1.0 表示完全偏爱平庸( 按正确的顺序正确排列梯度的所有四个步骤) ,\ tau 接近 0.0 表示随机评分, 负\ tau 表示积极偏爱文字翻译 。 表5显示了中间段级的\tau分数,并大致证实了二进制宏观偏好趋势:较老的“常规”QE指标和较小的LLM检查点显示出强烈的负相关关系,严重惩罚了偏差。 然而,关键是,跨中间步骤评价军衔顺序提供了将业绩最好的系统分开所需的解决办法。 虽然在评价全字性和平庸性的二进制极端时, rimx_24_hybrid_xxl和gemba_gemma4_31b大致平面出现, 但肯德尔的\tau分析揭示了“常规”QE 度量的性能界限。 Metrix_24_hybrid_xxl 拼命将中间端的33%和66%的句子混合物进行可靠排序,结果在阿拉伯语(τ=0.355\tau=0.355)和法语(τ=0.387\tau=0.387)等语言上只产生中度关联,形成鲜明的对比,gemba_gemma4_31b保持近乎完美的单音跟踪,实现τ=Tau的分数超过0.9000.900,绝大多数语言. 这表明,虽然大型常规系统能够可靠地捕捉到极端对比,但31B LLM更有能力跟踪微妙的 " 现实世界 " 水平的偏差和字迹。

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: The state of the art in QE research was shaped through successive editions of WMT shared tasks beginning in 2012 ( Callison-Burch et al., 2012 ; Bojar et al., 2013 ; Bojar et al., 2014 ; Bojar et al., 2015 ; Bojar et al., 2016 ; Bojar et al., 2017 ; Specia et al., 2018 ; Fonseca et al., 2019 ; Specia et al., 2020 ; Specia et al., 2021 ; Zerva et al., 2022 ; Blain et al., 2023 ; Zerva et al., 2024 ; Lavie et al., 2025 ) , though QE as a research program had substantial precedents under the banner of “confidence estimation” ( Gandrabur and Foster, 2003 ; Quirk, 2004 ; Blatz et al., 2004 ; Ueffing and Ney, 2005 ; Specia et al., 2009 ; Xiong et al., 2010 ; Bach et al., 2011 , inter alia ) . Zhao et al. (2024) offer a comprehensive survey of QE research, grouping approaches into three categories that also reflect the historical evolution of the task: handcrafted-feature-based systems ( Specia et al., 2013 ; Specia et al., 2015 , inter alia ) , deep-learning-based systems—a category subdivided into “classic deep learning methods” ( Kreutzer et al., 2015 ; Kim and Lee, 2016 ; Kim et al., 2017 ; Ive et al., 2018 ; Martins et al., 2017 , inter alia ) and “methods incorporating pre-trained language models”, the subcategory to which COMET and MetricX systems belong—and LLM-based approaches, to which the GEMBA framework belongs.
blocks.zh: 从2012年开始,通过连续版的WMT共享任务(Callison-Burch等人,2012年;Bojar等人,2013年;Bojar等人,2014年;Bojar等人,2015年;Bojar等人,2016年;Bojar等人,2017年;Specia等人,2018年;Fonseca等人,2019年;Specia等人,2020年;Specia等人,2021年;Zerva等人,2022年;Blain等人,2023年;Zerva等人,2024年;Lavie等人,2025年),虽然QE作为一个研究方案,在“信心估计”的旗帜下具有实质性先例(Gandrabur and Foster,2003年;Quirk,2004年;Blatz等人,2004年;Ueffing and Ney,2005年;Speia等人,2009年;Xiong等人,2010年;Bach等人,2011年)。 Zhao等人(2024年)提供了对QE研究的全面调查,将方法分为三个类别,这些类别也反映了任务的历史演变:手工开发的地貌系统 (Specia等人,2013年;Specia等人,2015年等),基于深层学习的系统——这一类别细分为“经典深层学习方法” (Kreutzer等人,2015年;Kim and Lee,2016年;Kim等人,2017年;Ive等人,2018年;Martins等人,2017年等)和“包含经过预先培训的语言模型的方法”,CAWT和MetricX系统所属的亚类——和基于LLM的方法,GEMBA框架属于这些方法.

blocks.en: Recent studies have begun probing the specific failure modes and biases of QE systems. Work by Zaranis et al. (2025) , which is closest to our own in its methodology, audited the gender biases of QE systems, showing that they systematically favor masculine-inflected translations when gender is ambiguous in source segments. Contemporaneously, Tian et al. (2026) investigated the broader challenges reference-based and reference-free metrics face when evaluating non-literal translations (spanning social media slang and puns, culture-specific realia , and the literary domain) for the English-Chinese language pair, demonstrating that traditional QE metrics correlate poorly with human preferences in non-literal translation contexts, whereas LLM-as-a-judge approaches align most closely. To the best of our knowledge, ours is the first study of QE focused strictly on idiom translation, though the topic of idiom translation itself has received ample treatment in MT research ( Wehrli, 1998 ; Anastasiou, 2010 ; Salton et al., 2014b ; Salton et al., 2014a ; Martins et al., 2017 ; Santing et al., 2022 ; Zaitova et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Gasparovic et al., 2025 ; Thanh Nguyen and Kordjamshidi, 2025 ; Donthi et al., 2025 ; Arslan et al., 2025 ; Rezaeimanesh et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Montesinos et al., 2026 , inter alia ) .
blocks.zh: 最近的研究已经开始调查量化排放制度的具体故障模式和偏差。 Zaranis等人(2025年)在方法上最接近我们自己的工作,对质权制度的性别偏见进行了审计,显示当源头部分的性别模棱两可时,它们有系统地倾向于男性化翻译。 同时,Tian等人(2026年)也调查了在评价英文-中文对等语的非文学翻译时,基于参考和无参考的衡量标准所面临的更广泛挑战(扩展社交媒体的长语和短语、文化特异性现实和文学领域),表明传统的QE衡量标准与非文学翻译情况下的人类偏好关系不佳,而LLM-as-a-judget 方法最为一致。 据我们所知,我们对QE的第一项研究是严格侧重于idiom翻译,尽管idiom翻译本身在MT研究中得到了充分的处理(Wehrli,1998年;Anastasiou,2010年;Salton等人,2014年b;Salton等人,2014年a;Martins等人,2017年;Santing等人,2022年;Zaitova等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年;Gasparovic等人,2025年;Thanh Nguyen和Kordjamshidi,2025年;Donthi等人,2025年;Arslan等人,2025年;Rezaeimanesh等人,2025年;Jiang等人,2026年;Montesinos等人,2026年等)。

blocks.en: Flor et al. (2025) present an extensive inventory of idiom corpora, 17 17 17 Also maintained as an updated online repository: https://github.com/maafiah/IdiomsResearch distinguishing between datasets compiled for the purpose of psycholinguistic and second language acquisition research on the one hand ( Cronk et al., 1993 ; Libben and Titone, 2008 ; Caillies, 2009 ; Morid and Sabourin, 2024 , 19 corpora; inter alia, ) , and natural language processing research on the other hand (34 corpora). The latter category comprises a wide range of datasets, and includes a few parallel corpora, with idioms used in context and translated idiomatically into a target language ( Fadaee et al., 2018 ; Stap et al., 2024 ) , idioms in their dictionary citation form with idiomatic translations in target languages ( Tang, 2022 ; Agrawal et al., 2018 ; Moussallem et al., 2018 ; Li et al., 2024 ) , as well as monolingual “parallel” corpora consisting in idioms paired with an explicit paraphrase in the same language ( Zhou et al., 2021 ; Liu and Hwa, 2016 ; Pershina et al., 2015 ) , with Tayyar Madabushi et al. (2021) additionally providing literal paraphrases of idioms in the same language for a subset of their corpus. 18 18 18 Another dataset offering such annotations was recently compiled by Almheiri et al. (2026) . The dataset closest to our own is the concurrently compiled G-IdiomAlign benchmark ( Ye et al., 2026 ) , which pairs cross-lingual idioms automatically retrieved from Wiktionary in their dictionary form and notably includes literal translations to evaluate LLM bias toward literal transfer. Our own work complements it in at least one critical way, by featuring idioms embedded within full sentences, as approaches relying on absolute dictionary citation forms naturally tend to abstract away the discourse often required to disambiguate literal from figurative usage. To the best of our knowledge, ours is the first dataset to align idiom-containing source sentences with idiomatic and literal translations across a graded continuum.
blocks.zh: Flor等人(2025年)提供了一份广泛的Idiom Corpora清单,17 17 17 并作为一个更新的在线存储库:https://github.com/maafiah/IdiomsResearch 区分为心理语言学和第二语言获取研究而汇编的数据集(Cronk等人,1993年;Liben和Titone,2008年;Caillies,2009年;Moid和Sabourin,2024年;19 corpora;等等),以及自然语言处理研究(34 corpora)。 后一类包括一系列广泛的数据集,并包括几个平行的corpora,在上下文中使用idioms,并用idioms翻译为目标语言(Fadaee等人,2018年;Stap等人,2024年),其字典引文形式中有idioms,以idioms翻译为目标语言(Tang,2022年;Agrawal等人,2018年;Moussallem等人,2018年;Li等人,2024年),以及单一语言的“平行”corpora,由idioms配对,并用同一种语言的明确参数(Zhou等人,2021年;Liu和Hwa,2016年;Pershina等人,2015年),Tayyar Madabushi等人(2021年),另外为他们的一个子集提供了同一语言的ioms的字面词。 与我们最接近的数据集是同时编译的G-IdiomAlign基准(Ye et al., 2026年),该基准对跨语言的idioms以词典形式自动从Wiktionary检索,并特别包括文字翻译,以评估LLM偏向字面转移. 我们自己的工作以至少一种关键的方式补充了它,它以包含在满句中的字典为特征,因为依赖绝对字典引用形式的方法自然倾向于抽象出通常需要的言语,使文字与虚构的用法脱节。 就我们所知,我们的数据集是第一个将含有idom的源句与一个分级连续体的diom和literal翻译一致的数据集.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced a novel parallel idiom dataset of paired literal and idiomatic translations across nine languages, and used it to study the performance of QE systems in idiom translation. Our results show that while smaller models and older QE metrics exhibit a marked literality bias, scaling up model parameters reliably improves idiomatic sensitivity. Our findings also reveal that while the largest conventional QE metrics can successfully evaluate binary extremes of literality/idiomaticity, LLMs in the GEMBA regime are uniquely capable of accurately ranking more granular, intermediate gradations of these textual properties.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了9种语言的对等文字和平面翻译的新型平行idiom数据集,并用它来研究idiom翻译中的QE系统的表现. 我们的结果表明,虽然较小的模型和较老的QE指标显示出明显的字面偏差,但模型参数的扩大可靠地提高了偏差敏感性。 我们的研究结果还表明,虽然最大的常规QE指标能够成功地评价二进制的字面/二进制极端,但GEMBA制度中的LLMs具有独特的能力,能够准确排列这些文字特性的颗粒性、中间分级。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: English is our only source language. Our results may therefore overestimate QE performance on rarer, more culture-specific idioms, and they may not transfer to other source languages. Our nine target languages are also comparatively well resourced. The triplets were curated by the authors and native-speaker colleagues drawing on established lexicographical resources but without a formal validation protocol or inter-annotator agreement measure. Finally, the concatenated segments are generally topically incoherent rather than naturally occurring discourse, which might restrict this dataset’s usefulness for other downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 英语是我们唯一的源语言。 因此,我们的结果可能会高估在较稀有,更符合文化特点的平庸语上的QE性能,它们可能不会转移到其他源语言. 我们的9种目标语言也相对资源充足。 三胞胎由作者和讲母语的同事利用既定的词汇资源来管理,但没有正式的验证协议或通知人之间的协议措施。 最后,整齐的部分一般是专题上不一致的,而不是自然产生的,这可能会限制这一数据集对其他下游任务的用处。

blocks.en: We only evaluated open-weight systems (see Ethics Statement). Proprietary LLMs are therefore absent from our study in spite of their wide use as QE judges. Each LLM was queried with a single zero-shot DA-style prompt under greedy decoding. Other regimes, such as MQM-style error annotation, few-shot prompting or prompts that mention idiomaticity explicitly, may produce different behaviors. Finally, our observations about scale rest on few checkpoints per family, and size might be confounded with other factors such as distillation.
blocks.zh: 我们只评价了开放加权系统(见道德操守说明)。 因此,我们的研究中没有专有的有限责任公司,尽管它们作为质量控制法官被广泛使用。 每一个LLM都被一个零镜头DA风格的单镜头在贪婪的解码下被询问. 其他制度,如MQM风格的误差注释,几发提示或明确提到偏差的提示,可能会产生不同的行为. 最后,我们对规模的看法是,每个家庭的检查站很少,规模可能与蒸馏等其他因素混淆。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: We acknowledge the environmental impact of large-scale LLM inference, particularly with the reasoning modes enabled. We had initially planned a further comparison between literality/idiomaticity judgments and QE sensitivity to synthetic error patterns (word deletion and permutation, character deletion and permutation) in idiom-bearing sentences at several degrees of corruption, but chose to abandon this analysis as its compute cost and environmental impact did not appear justified in light of the limited insight it was expected to offer. Our work consumed allocations on a cluster that operates on largely decarbonized electricity, and we release all model outputs under CC licenses for re-use by the community (see below).
blocks.zh: 我们承认大规模LLM推论对环境的影响,特别是由于能够采用推理模式。 我们最初曾计划在几度腐败中进一步比较含词性/偏差判断和对合成错误模式的QE敏感性(文字删除和通俗化、人物删除和通俗化),但选择放弃这一分析,因为其计算成本和环境影响似乎不合理,因为人们期望它提供的见解有限。 我们的工作耗尽了对一个主要以去碳化电力为主的集群的拨款,我们根据CC许可发放所有模型产出,供社区重新使用(见下文)。

blocks.en: The dataset was constructed by the authors and consenting colleagues on a voluntary basis, with no compensation involved and no personal data collected. We screened the triplets for offensive content, but idioms can encode cultural or ethnic stereotypes, and some expressions in the dataset may carry such connotations.
blocks.zh: 数据集由提交人和同意的同事自愿构建,不涉及赔偿,也没有收集个人数据。 我们筛选了三胞胎攻击性的内容,但偶像可以编码文化或种族定型观念,数据集中的某些表达可能带有这样的内涵.

blocks.en: We used all models in accordance with their licenses and intended research use, limiting our experiments to open-weight models with permissive licenses to this specific end. We release the dataset under a CC BY-SA 4.0 license. We also release all LLM completions, including reasoning traces, and all QE metric scores under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, 19 19 19 In line with the least permissive license of those checkpoints. so that our results can be reproduced and reused by the community. The dataset is intended as an evaluation resource and will be published as a password-protected archive to prevent its inclusion in web crawls; we discourage—but do not prohibit—its use as training data for QE and MT systems.
blocks.zh: 我们根据许可证和研究用途使用所有模型,将我们的实验限制在开放式模型和许可性模型上。 我们以CC BY-SA 4.0许可证发布数据集. 我们还公布所有LLM完成情况,包括推理痕迹,以及根据CC BY-NC-SA 4.0的所有QE指标得分,19 19 符合这些检查站最不容许的许可证。 这样,我们的成果就可以被社区复制和再利用。 数据集旨在作为一种评价资源,并将作为一个受密码保护的档案发布,以防止它被包含在网络爬行中;我们劝阻——但并不禁止——将其用作QE和MT系统的培训数据.

blocks.en: QE systems are increasingly used in professional translation workflows. Our finding that many of them prefer literal over idiomatic renderings implies that, in such settings, skillful human translations could be scored below poor literal machine output. We encourage practitioners to keep human oversight in place wherever QE scores inform decisions about translated content or about translators’ work, especially for text domains rich in figurative language.
blocks.zh: QE系统越来越多地用于专业翻译工作流程. 我们发现,其中许多人更喜欢文字渲染,而不是平庸的渲染,这意味着,在这种环境下,熟练的人类翻译可以低于低劣的文字机器输出。 我们鼓励从业者在QE得分通知有关翻译内容或翻译工作的决定时,特别是在文字领域富含比喻语言的情况下,保持人类监督。

blocks.en: Appendix B Bootstrap Significance Test
blocks.zh: 附录B 意义测试

blocks.en: To compare the performance of all evaluated QE systems, we conducted a stratified bootstrap resampling analysis ( N = 1000 N=1000 iterations), computing the statistical significance of the differences in macro-preference ratios between every pair of systems while ensuring that each language pair contributes equally to the global evaluation. For quality metrics (COMET, GEMBA scale), this is calculated as the mean score of full literal translations divided by the mean score of full idiomatic translations. For error-based metrics (MetricX), the ratio is inverted to maintain reporting consistency. For each bootstrap iteration, the global macro-preference ratio was computed for every system. We then calculated the pairwise differences ( Δ \Delta ) by subtracting the column system’s ratio from the row system’s ratio. Two-tailed p p -values were derived by measuring the proportion of bootstrap iterations in which the calculated Δ \Delta crossed zero. Differences that achieved statistical significance ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ) are explicitly annotated with an asterisk (*) in the resulting heatmap. The resulting matrix provides a comprehensive system-wide comparison of literality bias. The numerical value inside each cell represents the mean Δ \Delta Macro-Preference Ratio (Row - Column). The diverging color palette (Red/Blue) visually encodes this difference. Red cells indicate a positive delta, meaning the row system exhibits a stronger literality bias than the column system. Conversely, blue cells indicate a negative delta, meaning the row system rates idiomatic translations higher than literal ones by a larger margin than the column system.
blocks.zh: 为了比较所有被评价的QE系统的性能,我们进行了分层的靴子重新取样分析(N=1000N=1000迭代),计算了每对系统之间宏观优先比差异的统计意义,同时确保每对语言对全球评价的贡献相等。 对于质量度量衡(COMET,GEMBA scale),这算作全字翻译的平均分除以全字翻译的平均分. 对于基于错误的度量衡(MetricX),该比率是倒置的,以保持报告的一致性. 每个系统都计算出全球宏观优先比。 然后我们通过从行系统的比例中减去列系统的比例来计算成对差异(\\\Delta)。 双尾 p - 值是通过测量所计算的 QQ \ Delta 跨越 0 时的靴带迭代比例得出 。 具有统计意义的差异(p < 0.05 p < 0.05)在产生的热图中明确加注星号(*)。 由此产生的矩阵对字面偏差作了全面的全系统比较。 每个单元格内的数字值代表平均值QQ\Delta宏优先比(Row - 列)。 不同颜色调色板(红色/蓝色)可视化编码这种差异。 红细胞表示正三角形,指行系表现出比列系更强的字形偏差. 反之,蓝色的单元格表示一个负三角形,意思是行系统比字面翻译高比列系统高一个较大的比值.
